_note: Community-standard baseline fits, curated for common early/mid-game roles. Module names and skill levels are representative, not pulled live from CCP data -- always let the in-game fitting screen have the final word on exact per-module skill gates. Extend this file with more ships/fits any time.

fits.name: Venture (Ore + Gas All-Rounder)
fits.summary: Buffer-tanked general-purpose Venture for highsec/lowsec ore mining that can also scan down and huff gas sites.
mid: Medium F-S9 Regolith Compact Shield Extender
rig: Small Core Defense Field Extender I
notes: Venture has only 2 turret hardpoints, so 2 mining lasers is the hard cap; the third high is free utility.
Miner II is roughly 40% better yield than Miner I; if CPU is tight, use Particle Bore Compact Mining Laser instead.
Shield extender plus EM/Thermal rigs patch the Venture's 0% EM and 20% thermal shield holes against gankers.
Swap both mining lasers for Gas Cloud Harvester I and use the probe launcher to scan gas sites in wormholes or nullsec.
Drop the probe launcher and survey scanner for a second shield module if you only mine belts in highsec.
Use Damage Control I if you lack Hull Upgrades V; the ship is cheap enough that it barely matters.
Built-in +2 warp core strength means a single scram or point cannot hold you, so pre-align and warp at the first sign of trouble.

fits.name: Buffer Retriever (Shield Anti-Gank Miner)
fits.summary: Solo high-sec/low-risk ore and ice mining barge with a shield buffer tank sized to deter cheap suicide ganks.
rig: Medium Core Defense Field Extender II
Medium Core Defense Field Extender II
Medium Core Defense Field Extender II
charges: Simple Asteroid Mining Crystal Type A II
Coherent Asteroid Mining Crystal Type A II
Variegated Asteroid Mining Crystal Type A II
Complex Asteroid Mining Crystal Type A II
notes: Retriever's draw is its huge ore hold, so buffer tank beats active tank — you want to survive long enough for CONCORD.
If CPU is tight before skills finish, drop to Strip Miner I and Mining Laser Upgrade I, then upgrade later.
Load Simple Type A crystals for Veldspar/Scordite; swap crystal families per ore type or use Ice Harvester II for ice.
Two Hobgoblin II clear belt rats; three Hornet EC-300 can break a ganker's lock and buy you a warp-out.
Always mine pre-aligned to a station or celestial and watch local — tank only buys seconds, not immunity.
In known gank systems (Hek, ice belts, Uedama route) fly a Procurer instead; it tanks far better for similar yield.

fits.name: Rifter (Armor Scram Brawler)
fits.summary: General-purpose solo/small-gang PvP Rifter that scram-webs targets and brawls at 0-9km with T2 autocannons behind a plate-and-ancillary armor buffer.
notes: Scram plus web plus afterburner is the core: kill enemy speed, then out-track and out-damage them up close.
Ammo: Republic Fleet EMP S or Fusion S inside ~4km, Barrage S out to the falloff bonus at ~8-9km, Hail S only against slow, webbed targets.
The Small Ancillary Armor Repairer runs unfueled but is far stronger with Nanite Repair Paste loaded; carry 30+ and reload only when disengaged.
Fitting is tight - the Small Ancillary Current Router II is what makes the 400mm plate and T2 guns fit; drop the plate for a Multispectrum Coating II if you prefer speed.
Alpha or low-SP pilots: swap to 200mm Light Prototype Automatic Cannons, Counterbalanced Compact Gyrostabilizer, Initiated Compact Warp Scrambler and a 200mm Rolled Tungsten Compact Plates.
Rifter has no drone bay, so overheating guns and the repairer is your only burst - heat early against other frigates.
Artillery variants (280mm Howitzer Artillery II with a microwarpdrive) exist for kiting, but the autocannon brawler is the more forgiving all-round choice.

fits.name: Merlin Blaster Brawler (ASB)
fits.summary: Cheap, tough Tech I close-range brawler for solo and small-gang PvP that also handles low-level PvE.
rig: Small Core Defense Field Extender II
notes: The Merlin's 4% shield resist bonus per Caldari Frigate level plus resist rigs makes the ancillary shield booster repair far above its paper numbers.
Load Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge S as your default; it beats Void S on tracking and range while keeping most of the damage.
Carry Null S for targets you cannot immediately close on, and swap to Void S only when scrammed and webbed inside 2 km.
Merlins are slow, so scram plus web first and fight at point-blank; disengaging is very hard once committed.
Popular variant: drop the shield booster for a second Fleeting Compact Stasis Webifier and add a Small Shield Extender II for a dual-web buffer brawler.
Budget version: swap to meta modules such as a 1MN Y-S8 Compact Afterburner, Warp Scrambler I and Anode Light Ion Particle Cannon I; Merlin has no drone bay, so bring no drones.

fits.name: Vexor Armor Brawler (Drone/Blaster)
fits.summary: Armor-buffer drone cruiser for low-sec/null roams and small gang that also handles ratting and combat sites.
notes: Drones are the main gun: the hull gives 10% drone damage and HP per Gallente Cruiser level.
Two Drone Damage Amplifier II plus a 5-drone medium flight is the standard damage core.
Blasters and the neut are close-range support; the neut shuts down tackle frigates.
Load Void M inside ~4km, Null M for 10-15km, Antimatter Charge M as a cheap all-rounder.
Ancillary rep gives burst tank on paste, while the 800mm plate and trimarks carry the buffer.
Fitting is tight: swap to 800mm Rolled Tungsten Compact Plates or meta blasters if grid-short.
Common variants: shield buffer for more low-slot damage mods, or 220mm Vulcan AutoCannon II to free capacitor.

fits.name: Brawl Cat (T2 Blaster Armor Brawler)
fits.summary: Cheap, high-DPS armor-buffer blaster Catalyst for lowsec/FW brawling, gate camps and general small-gang PvP.
notes: Catalyst has no drone bay, so all damage comes from the eight turrets — every gun counts.
Light Ion Blaster II is the sweet spot: near-Neutron damage with easier fitting and a little more range.
Ammo: Void S inside ~4 km, Caldari Navy Antimatter Charge S as the default, Null S when targets try to pull range.
Afterburner over MWD — it keeps signature small and still works under an enemy scram.
Scram plus a plate is the survival plan: get to zero, hold them there, and out-trade with raw DPS.
Common variants: swap to Light Neutron Blaster II for max gank, or 8x 150mm Railgun II with a Warp Disruptor II for a cheap kite/PvE version.
Only two mids means you can't have both web and scram; fly with fleetmates who bring tackle when possible.

fits.name: Armor Buffer Rupture (AC Brawler)
fits.summary: General-purpose armour-buffer autocannon Rupture for low-sec, fleet and small-gang brawling PvP.
notes: EVE University still lists armour buffer plus autocannons as the standard, most forgiving Rupture PvP approach.
Roughly 35-40k EHP with good skills, so it survives long enough for armour logi or friends to arrive.
Scram plus web is your brawl kit; the Warp Disruptor II gives sticky secondary tackle when the FC calls a long point.
Load Republic Fleet EMP M for shield targets up close, Republic Fleet Phased Plasma M for armour, Barrage M when the fight drifts past 6-8 km.
Utility high is flexible: swap the Medium Energy Neutralizer II for a Small Energy Neutralizer II if powergrid or fitting skills are tight.
Warrior II handle tackle frigates; carry Hobgoblin II as spares or for cruiser-sized targets you can hold still.
Common variation is a shield version (Large Shield Extender II, extra Gyrostabilizer II) which is faster and hits harder but has less EHP.

fits.name: Passive Drake (PvE Missions & Ratting)
fits.summary: General-purpose passive-shield heavy missile boat for Level 3 missions, combat anomalies and relaxed ratting.
rig: Medium Core Defense Field Purger II
Medium Core Defense Field Purger II
Medium Core Defense Field Purger II
notes: Passive tank: purger rigs, Shield Power Relays and hardeners give constant regen with zero capacitor use.
The Drake's 5% kinetic missile bonus means Scourge Fury Heavy Missile is your default ammo.
Carry Scourge Precision Heavy Missile for frigates; let the light drones handle fast tacklers.
Swap Thermal Dissipation Field II for a faction-appropriate hardener (or Kinetic Deflection Field II vs Guristas).
If CPU is tight before Electronics skills are maxed, use Compact hardeners and Medium Core Defense Field Purger I rigs.
This is a Level 3 / anomaly ship; Level 4 missions are slow and risky in a T1 Drake, so blitz or bring a battleship.
Keep the afterburner running and stay 40-60 km off the spawn — the Drake is slow and dies to being wrapped up.

fits.name: Armor Cane (Autocannon Brawler)
fits.summary: General-purpose armor-buffered autocannon Hurricane for solo and small-gang PvP in low/null and wormhole space.
notes: Armor buffer plus dual membranes gives a fat, cheap EHP pool that logi and drugs scale well with.
220mm autocannons keep powergrid comfortable alongside the 1600mm plate; swap to 425mm AutoCannon II once Advanced Weapon Upgrades is high.
Load Republic Fleet EMP M as default, Hail M when webbed and inside 3 km, Barrage M against kiters or drones.
Scram-web-neut is the win condition: get inside 7 km, kill their prop mod, then eat their cap.
Wiki-noted alternative is the shield artillery cane (720mm Howitzer Artillery II, Large Shield Extender II) for fleet alpha at range.
Utility high can be a Medium Energy Nosferatu II instead if you want cap sustain rather than shutting down active-tanked opponents.

fits.name: Raven L4 Missioner (Cruise/MJD)
fits.summary: General-purpose PvE battleship for Level 4 security missions, kiting at range with cruise missiles and an active shield tank.
mid: X-Large Clarity Ward Enduring Shield Booster
notes: Cruise missiles, not torpedoes: torps give under 10% more paper DPS for far worse range and application.
Core tactic is Micro Jump Drive 100 km off, then shoot the room while most NPC damage falls off.
Swap the EM Shield Hardener II for the hardener matching each faction's main damage type.
Fury ammo for battleships; load Scourge Precision Cruise Missile and let drones handle frigates.
The shield booster is a burst tank — pulse it manually instead of running it constantly.
Budget version: swap launchers to 'Arbalest' Cruise Launcher I and rigs to Tech I until Cruise Missiles V is done.
